# CohortRecipes

The goal of CohortRecipes is to standardise common cohort definitions in
OMOP CDM. You can use your own conceptSets or the ones defined in
OmopConcepts.

## Installation

You can install the development version of CohortRecipes like so:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ohdsi/CohortRecipes")
```

Or from CRAN:

``` r
install.packages("CohortRecipes")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`addObesity()`](https://ohdsi.github.io/CohortRecipes/reference/addObesity.md)
  : Add obesity flag
- [`bmiThreshold`](https://ohdsi.github.io/CohortRecipes/reference/bmiThreshold.md)
  : BMI obesity thresholds
- [`obesityCohort()`](https://ohdsi.github.io/CohortRecipes/reference/obesityCohort.md)
  : Create the obesity cohort
